title: Tokyo Station
visualBrief: Restored red-brick Marunouchi historic frontage, three storeys, cream stone bands/window frames, paired curved octagonal dome roofs, central gabled clock entrance, mansard wings and corner turrets.
scaleBasis: Selected published dimensions where cited; remaining lengths and details are provisional artistic values.
geometrySource: Original deterministic Molen mesh generator; no third-party model or bitmap texture.
placementStatus: Reviewed approximate PMTiles historic-frontage fit; accepted limits in qa.json.

appearance.identity: Restored red-brick Marunouchi historic frontage, three storeys, cream stone bands/window frames, paired curved octagonal dome roofs, central gabled clock entrance, mansard wings and corner turrets.
appearance.exclusions: Rear/Yaesu buildings, train platforms and roof complex, underground station and complete interiors are excluded from this frontage asset.

nativeAxes.origin: Approximate mapped western historic-frontage strip centre at reconstructed floor. +X south along the facade.

sourceFacts.reviewScope: Current medium-fi Marunouchi exterior using picture/PMTiles fit. The prior coarse draft remains reproducible in the unchanged buildTokyoStation function; a separate reviewed recipe improves dome curvature, three storeys and entrance/roof identity.
sourceFacts.reconstructed: 335m native draft length scaled to319.177m mapped long-axis reference; body depth32m and dome/roof heights are visual approximations, not architectural surveys.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Inspected frontage picture supports red brick, three storeys, cream bands, mansard wings and curved octagonal dome assemblies. Standard PMTiles separates the western low-rise combined station building from long platform-roof polygons. Its319m long axis and71.7m combined depth locate an approximate32m-wide western historic-frontage strip; the asset covers this Marunouchi frontage, not all Tokyo Station. Native+X follows the southward frontage axis; native+Z faces the west-northwest plaza. Native source335m length is scaled to the mapped319m frontage reference. Standard PMTiles centre contact plane establishes the approximate working floor; sampled footing corners descend to surrounding grade, and high urban samples beneath the roof are suppressed only under bounded covered architecture. Coarse PMTiles city mounds are retained outside the model and are not claimed as accurate plaza grade. No precise frontage/member survey is claimed.

limitations: Approximate historic Marunouchi frontage only, located using inspected picture and standard viewer PMTiles; exact member footprints, thresholds and dome/pavilion dimensions are reconstructed.
Separate reviewed exterior recipe improves the previous draft. Its original builder and draft hash remain available; source and every browser level build deterministically from Git recipes.

Shared brick, limestone, slate and standing-seam textures; no unique image duplication. Clock/trim/dormer inventories and rear elevations are simplified; closed interiors, platform complex, Yaesu side and train traffic are excluded.

Bounded covered-floor opening avoids coarse urban terrain through the model and preserves raw surroundings. Footprint replacement stays off. No bespoke survey, engineering fidelity or physical-device timing is claimed.
reviewStatus: medium-fi; current hash-bound acceptance is recorded in qa.json
